title: Proton pump inhibitors and hypomagnesemia: a meta-analysis of observational studies
authors: Srinutta T, Chewcharat A, Takkavatakarn K, Praditpornsilpa K, Eiam-Ong S, Jaber BL, et al.
population: 16 observational studies (13 cross-sectional, 2 case-control, 1 cohort) searched to June 2018
funder: The authors have no funding and conflicts of interest to disclose.
result: Hypomagnesaemia in 19.4% (95% CI 13.8% to 26.5%) of PPI users against 13.5% (7.9% to 22.2%) of non-users; pooled adjusted OR 1.71 (1.33 to 2.19); high-dose against low-dose use adjusted OR 2.13 (1.26 to 3.59). No randomised trials were available.
